connect4if.description:
Connect4IF is a Connect 4 game developed in Prolog as part of the ALIA course at INSA Lyon.
It allows you to play against another player or against 4 different artificial intelligences: random, weighted, offensive, defensive, Minimax.

zarbif.description: ZarbIF is a website displaying Pokémon information from SPARQL queries via Wikidata and TriplyDB, and also performs queries to the PokéApi to complete missing information from the semantic web.

ifcc.description:
IFCC is a C to assembly compiler multi-target (x86-64, ARM64) developed in C++.
It supports a significant subset of the C language, handles basic types, control structures, functions, arrays, structures and performs static analysis to ensure code robustness.
The compiler relies on an Intermediate Representation (IR) for optimization and retargeting.

tsp_genetic.description:
